title: 1990 AMC 8 Problem 2
statement: Which digit of \(0.12345,\) when changed to \(9,\) gives the largest number?

solutions.text:
Changing a digit in the tenths place changes the number more than changing any digit farther to the right. The digit in the tenths place is \(1\).

Changing it gives \(0.92345\), which is the largest possible result.

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: Changing a digit in a higher place value raises the number by more
The leftmost digit \(1\) sits in the tenths place, the largest place value shown
